walkthrough:
Identify the coordinates of points $A$ and $E$:
$$A(2, 4), \quad E(2.1, 4.63566)$$

Apply the chord gradient formula $m_{AE} = \frac{y_E - y_A}{x_E - x_A}$:
$$m_{AE} = \frac{4.63566 - 4}{2.1 - 2} = \frac{0.63566}{0.1} = 6.3566$$

$$m_{AF} = 7.2288 \quad (x = 3)$$
$$m_{AE} = 6.3566 \quad (x = 2.1)$$
$$m_{AD} = 6.2608 \quad (x = 2.01)$$
$$m_{AC} = 6.2511 \quad (x = 2.001)$$
$$m_{AB} = 6.2501 \quad (x = 2.0001)$$

Deduce the limiting value as $\Delta x \to 0$:
$$f'(2) = \lim_{x \to 2} \frac{f(x) - f(2)}{x - 2} = 6.25$$
